name: Insulate a shelter
summary: Stop moving air first: draughts steal more heat than thin walls. Then insulate the room you actually live in, floor included. Walk-in cooler panels are thick foam sandwich walls that bolt up into a ready-made insulated room, and foam from mattresses, cooler boxes and packaging all helps.

parts.why: Batts, foam boards and loose fill
Mattress foam, door seals and floor pads
Frames to hold insulation in place
Foam walls from coolers and insulated boxes

tips: Old grey-brown pebbly loft insulation (vermiculite) may hold asbestos. Leave it alone.
Clear plastic taped tight over a window frame adds an insulating air gap.
Glass fibre insulation itches and irritates lungs. Wear a mask, gloves and long sleeves.
Cold ground pulls heat out fast. Insulate the floor too.
Keep a little ventilation: a sealed room with people in it gets damp and mouldy.
